baselineObserved.basis: New regression tests executed against the current workspace before these production fixes, not against a clean git HEAD.

checks.finding: Get/List title remained original after a committed rename and database reopen. Two sequential renames undid to the intermediate state title. Atomic-failure cases already passed.
All seven dependency/inverse round-trip subcases failed: original-order inverses and repeated note deltas did not restore the original state, or attempted dependent removals/shrinks too early.

limits: Fixes apply to subsequent successful writes and newly generated inverses; existing bad inverse history is not recomputed, migrated or automatically replayed.
Startup/reads do not bulk-repair existing mismatched title metadata. A later successful transaction writes the final state title as usual.
Round-trip coverage is the named cases, not every combination of supported operations or old histories.
Browser reload and SQLite reopen were tested; no native Wails process kill, power-loss or cross-platform filesystem acceptance.
Mock picker check proves the suggested filename only; actual MIDI file content was separately round-tripped through IPC.
No new native window, physical audio/device, real-model or dense-canvas performance acceptance in this increment.
developmentFindings: The IPC regression initially sent both id and projectId to strict method decoders; corrected to each existing method schema without relaxing production decoding.
The added browser reload initially checked unchanged old-page content before navigation completed; it now requires a different performance.timeOrigin and the new page readiness before asserting.
A missing standard-library slices import was caught and corrected before successful test runs.

documentationReview.focus: Full affected-document reread and cross-check of title atomicity, inverse order, preserved interfaces, history limits and acceptance status; not a repository-wide completeness claim.
